name: cisa-cybersecurity-mcp-server
description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities with BOD 26-04 deadlines, SSVC prioritization, and the full ICS advisory corpus (CSAF) via MCP. Keyless. STDIO & Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities with BOD 26-04 deadlines, SSVC prioritization, and the full ICS advisory corpus (CSAF).
interface.longDescription: MCP server over CISA's open vulnerability outputs: the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with federal remediation deadlines under BOD 26-04, the SSVC decision points CISA publishes per CVE in Vulnrichment, the complete Industrial Control Systems advisory corpus in CSAF form, and the current CISA alert feeds. Keyless.
